ifrsComponents.description: The IFRS primary statements present in the complete set (IAS 1.10): financialPosition, profitOrLossOci, changesInEquity, cashFlows, notes.
ifrsComponents.title: Ifrs Components

cashFlowStatement.description: Cash flows classified into operating, investing and financing activities (IAS 7.10 / ASC 230), reconciling to the net change in cash for the period.

operating.description: Net cash flow from operating activities.
operating.title: Operating

investing.description: Net cash flow from investing activities.
investing.title: Investing

financing.description: Net cash flow from financing activities.
financing.title: Financing

netChange.description: Net increase/decrease in cash and cash equivalents.
netChange.title: Net Change

cashFlowStatement.title: Cash Flow Statement

pnlCategories.description: The IFRS 18.47 income/expense categories presented in the statement of profit or loss: operating, investing, financing, incomeTaxes, discontinuedOperations.
pnlCategories.title: Pnl Categories

operatingProfitSubtotal.description: The operating profit-or-loss subtotal required by IFRS 18.69.
operatingProfitSubtotal.title: Operating Profit Subtotal

inventoryCostFormula.description: Cost formula for interchangeable inventories (IAS 2.25). FIFO or weighted-average is permitted; LIFO is prohibited.
inventoryCostFormula.title: Inventory Cost Formula

internalGoodwillRecognised.description: True when internally generated goodwill is recognised as an asset. IAS 38.48 prohibits this — compliant statements set this false.
internalGoodwillRecognised.title: Internal Goodwill Recognised

internalBrandsRecognised.description: True when internally generated brands, mastheads, customer lists, etc., are recognised as intangible assets. IAS 38.63 prohibits this — compliant statements set this false.
internalBrandsRecognised.title: Internal Brands Recognised

goodwillImpairmentReversed.description: True when a goodwill impairment loss has been reversed. IAS 36.124 prohibits this — compliant statements set this false.
goodwillImpairmentReversed.title: Goodwill Impairment Reversed

contingentLiabilityRecognised.description: True when a contingent liability has been recognised. IAS 37.27 forbids recognition (disclosure only) — compliant statements set this false.
contingentLiabilityRecognised.title: Contingent Liability Recognised

fxInitialMeasurement.description: Initial recognition of a foreign-currency transaction at the spot rate at the transaction date (IAS 21.21): recordedAmount = foreignAmount x spotRate.

spotRate.description: Spot exchange rate at the transaction date.
spotRate.title: Spot Rate

recordedAmount.description: Functional-currency amount recorded on initial recognition.
recordedAmount.title: Recorded Amount

fxInitialMeasurement.title: Fx Initial Measurement

monetaryItemRateType.description: Exchange rate applied to foreign-currency monetary items at the reporting date. IAS 21.23(a) requires the closing rate.
monetaryItemRateType.title: Monetary Item Rate Type

nonMonetaryHistoricalRateType.description: Exchange rate applied to non-monetary items measured at historical cost. IAS 21.23(b) requires the transaction-date (historical) rate.
nonMonetaryHistoricalRateType.title: Non Monetary Historical Rate Type

currentTaxPosition.description: Current-tax position (IAS 12.12): unpaid current tax is recognised as a liability, any excess paid as an asset. The classification matches the sign of unpaidCurrentTax.

unpaidCurrentTax.description: Unpaid current tax for current and prior periods (negative when overpaid).
unpaidCurrentTax.title: Unpaid Current Tax

currentTaxPosition.title: Current Tax Position

deferredTaxDiscounted.description: True when deferred tax assets/liabilities are discounted. IAS 12.53 prohibits discounting — compliant statements set this false.
deferredTaxDiscounted.title: Deferred Tax Discounted

deferredTaxClassification.description: Balance-sheet classification of deferred tax. ASC 740 requires non-current classification on a classified balance sheet.
deferredTaxClassification.title: Deferred Tax Classification

shortTermBenefitsDiscounted.description: True when short-term employee benefits are discounted. IAS 19.11 requires the undiscounted amount — compliant statements set this false.
shortTermBenefitsDiscounted.title: Short Term Benefits Discounted

creditRiskExposure.description: IFRS 9 credit-risk staging for a representative financial asset. The 30-DPD SICR (5.5.11) and 90-DPD default (B5.5.37) presumptions are rebuttable.

sicrRebutted.description: True when the 30-DPD SICR presumption is rebutted with reasonable supportable information.
sicrRebutted.title: Sicr Rebutted

defaultRebutted.description: True when the 90-DPD default presumption is rebutted.
defaultRebutted.title: Default Rebutted

inDefault.description: True when the asset is classified in default.
inDefault.title: In Default

creditRiskExposure.title: Credit Risk Exposure

acquisitionDate.description: Acquisition date of a business combination (IFRS 3 / ASC 805), from which the measurement period runs.
acquisitionDate.title: Acquisition Date

measurementPeriodEnd.description: End of the business-combination measurement period. IFRS 3.45 / ASC 805 cap it at one year after the acquisition date.
measurementPeriodEnd.title: Measurement Period End

investeeVotingPowerPct.description: Percentage of voting power held in an investee. IAS 28 / ASC 323 presume significant influence (equity method) at 20% or more.
investeeVotingPowerPct.title: Investee Voting Power Pct

equityMethodApplied.description: True when the equity method is applied to the investment. Consistent with investeeVotingPowerPct >= 20%.
equityMethodApplied.title: Equity Method Applied

financingExpedientApplied.description: True when the IFRS 15.63 no-significant-financing-component practical expedient is applied (only valid when transferToPaymentDays <= 365).
financingExpedientApplied.title: Financing Expedient Applied

transferToPaymentDays.description: Expected number of days between transfer of goods/services and customer payment, for the IFRS 15.63 expedient.
transferToPaymentDays.title: Transfer To Payment Days

costObtainingExpedientApplied.description: True when the IFRS 15.94 practical expedient (expensing incremental costs of obtaining a contract) is applied (only valid when costAmortisationMonths <= 12).
costObtainingExpedientApplied.title: Cost Obtaining Expedient Applied

costAmortisationMonths.description: Amortisation period (in months) of the costs of obtaining a contract, for the IFRS 15.94 expedient.
costAmortisationMonths.title: Cost Amortisation Months

leaseRecognition.description: Lessee lease recognition (IFRS 16.22/16.37): right-of-use asset and lease liability at commencement, and the first-period interest at a constant periodic rate.

openingLiability.description: Opening lease liability for the first period.
openingLiability.title: Opening Liability

discountRate.description: Discount rate (periodic) used to unwind the liability.
discountRate.title: Discount Rate

leaseRecognition.title: Lease Recognition

shortTermLease.description: ASC 842 short-term-lease exemption: a lease of 12 months or less with no reasonably certain purchase option may be exempted by class.

purchaseOptionLikely.description: True when a purchase option is reasonably certain to be exercised.
purchaseOptionLikely.title: Purchase Option Likely

exemptionElected.description: True when the short-term exemption is elected (valid only when termMonths <= 12 and no purchase option).
exemptionElected.title: Exemption Elected

shortTermLease.title: Short Term Lease

classifiedBalanceSheet.description: ASC 210 classified balance sheet separating current from non-current assets and liabilities.

currentAssets.description: Assets expected to be realised within one year or the operating cycle.
currentAssets.title: Current Assets

currentLiabilities.description: Liabilities expected to be settled within one year or the operating cycle.
currentLiabilities.title: Current Liabilities

classifiedBalanceSheet.title: Classified Balance Sheet

comprehensiveIncome.description: ASC 220 comprehensive income: net income plus other comprehensive income equals total comprehensive income, in a single or two-statement format.

otherComprehensiveIncome.description: Other comprehensive income for the period.
otherComprehensiveIncome.title: Other Comprehensive Income

comprehensiveIncome.title: Comprehensive Income

asc848ModificationDate.description: Date a contract modification or hedging relationship relies on ASC 848 reference-rate-reform relief. The relief sunsets after 31 December 2024.
asc848ModificationDate.title: Asc848Modification Date

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Financial Statement is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.
